day_read: This is a down-trend day on monthly expiry. Nifty is -1.3% and BankNifty -2.3% from the open, both sitting at the bottom of their ranges (0.06 and 0.10), breadth is 13/37 and VIX is up. Price is now pinned near the 25400 put wall with a small short-covering uptick and 28 minutes left, so there is little room for new trend legs and late fades remain risky.

bollinger_fade.why: Fade model on a trend day, and worst three days running. Keep it off.

vwap_revert.why: Fading stretches on a trend day is losing (-424, 3/13). Keep it off.

volume_burst.why: Volume is back near normal (1.0-1.5x), but the default is -677 on 32 trades and @ai -87. It shows no edge and overtrades into charges. Stay off.

rsi2.why: Up +113 (10/12), but price is at the low by the put wall in thin volume, so more short pullback entries offer poor risk and reward. Bank the gain and stay off.

orb.why: +92 on 3 trades with the short-only 30-minute setup, which fits the day. No change; new triggers are unlikely this late.

vwap_trend.why: Best on the bench (+542, 20/27), so keep it short-only. With under 30 minutes left and the put wall pinning price, trim the target so a new short can actually hit it before the 14:50 flat.

opening_drive_fade.why: The first-30-minute window is over, and fading the down drive is counter-trend.

ema_cross.why: The default is 0/6 (-269) and @ai 0/3 (-142). Crossovers whipsaw in this tape. Stay off.

squeeze_break.why: The default is 0/5 (-281) and @ai -77. Fresh breakdowns at the day low against the 25500 put wall have little room. Stay off.
